column1: # The read benchmark's background (eukore/reads.py, since 2026-11-06): bacteria and an archaeon of the human gut and
# the lab, whose reads a eukaryote reference should leave alone. NCBI RefSeq genomes, fetched by the fetch stage into
# WORK/sources/read_background/<accession>.fna.gz. Columns: RefSeq accession (or a sequence's, fetched by E-utilities),
# assembly name, organism, and a eukaryote's NCBI taxid (since 2026-11-09): its reads are right on its own lineage and
# wrong elsewhere, and it is no false detection in a sample. Human chromosome 21 is the host's DNA of a gut or skin
# metagenome, repeats (Alu, L1, satellites) and all: absent from a trial package, its reads should stay unplaced or
# high; in a full one, on Homo.
